youtube.title: Julius Caesar wore his laurel wreath EVERYWHERE. Here's why 🌿 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Why did Julius Caesar never take off his laurel wreath? 🌿

Team Caesar or Team Senate? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: the Roman historian Suetonius wrote that Caesar was embarrassed by his baldness, combed his thin hair forward, and that of all the honors the Senate gave him, the one he liked most was the right to wear a laurel wreath at all times.
